svg.title: Cognitive DataOps data model
svg.desc: Edge gateways publish over MQTT to a Node service that stores devices and time-series readings. Assets, mesh nodes and sensor bindings form the twin, joined to telemetry by sensorId.
svg.text: Two ESP32 gateways play a welding robot and a stamping press. Telemetry joins the twin through sensorId.
device status, Last Will, sequence loss
binding index: sensorId to mesh name
1 when the clock was not trusted
registry, rebuilt from retained birth and status
Partial unique indexes, where isActive is true:
sensorId a sensor drives at most one mesh
meshNodeId a mesh has at most one sensor
MongoDB time-series collection, expires after 48 hours
PK primary key FK foreign key
